description: This file contains a React hook providing CRUD operations and analytics for managing 'links' in a Supabase database. It encapsulates functions to list, create, update, delete, and increment clicks on links, as well as retrieve user-specific analytics.

methods.name: useLinksService()
methods.description: Main hook exposing link management functions for React components.

methods.name: listByUser
methods.description: Fetches a list of links for the current user with optional filtering and sorting.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new link record in the database for the current user.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing link owned by the current user.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a link owned by the current user.

methods.name: incrementClicks
methods.description: Increments the click count for a link, optionally via RPC.

methods.name: analytics
methods.description: Returns total links and clicks count for the current user.
